text:
sarah_finance: Quick FYI — we issued a one-off promo credit to ACME today tied to the Jan–Feb pricing experiment. Total credit issued: $96,000 (credit memo on 2026-03-15). Need guidance for month-end revenue treatment; should this be deferred or recorded as contra-revenue?

sarah_finance: Details: credit created as invoice adjustment (not a prepaid deposit). ACME also signed a 12-month dedicated commit starting 2026-03-01, but the credit explicitly references prior usage. I'm leaning contra-rev but want tax/GAAP check. CC: @alex_revenue @lisa_acct

alex_revenue: Quick thought — if the credit is retrospective (adjusting previously delivered performance) treat as contra-revenue now. If it's tied to future obligations (customer consideration for future service) it's a deferral and amortize over the service period. From your note it sounds retrospective.

mike_fpna: One nuance — commercial team phrased it as an 'onboarding credit' to close the Dedicated deal. If there is a contractual term (12 months) and it's inducement to commit, GAAP usually treats as a reduction to revenue recognized over the term. Can we confirm the language in the credit memo?

sarah_finance: Copy of invoice memo pasted below:
```
'Customer credit: $96,000 applied to prior platform overage invoices (Jan–Feb). Credit issued as part of Dedicated onboarding incentive; amortization to be evaluated against contract.'
```
So it's mixed language.

lisa_acct: Given that, I recommend deferral over the committed term. Practical options:
- Option A (contra-rev now): Recognize entire $96k as contra-revenue in Mar, simpler but may misstate matching if tied to future service.
- Option B (defer): Post to REV_DEF_2026 and amortize monthly over 12 months => $8,000/mo.
I lean Option B to match the Dedicated term.

alex_revenue: I agree with Lisa. For controls we should: 1) use REV_DEF_2026 GL, 2) create recurring JE template: DR REV_DEF_2026 96,000 / CR Revenue_Monthly 8,000 each month for 12 months, starting 2026-03-31, and 3) attach the credit memo & sales note.

mike_fpna: OK from FP&A — amortize over 12 months. Impact to ARR and churn metrics noted in the model. I'll update forecasts.

lisa_acct: I'll prepare the initial journal and post the deferral on 03/31. @sarah_finance please confirm you reclass the credit memo to REV_DEF_2026 in billing system by EOD.

sarah_finance: Confirmed — will reclassify and send a screenshot here when done. Thanks all :thumbsup:

month-end-bot: Reminder: month-end JE cutoff in 48 hours. Please ensure all supporting docs uploaded to /finance/month-close/2026-03.
